content.title: Live Updates: Highlights Across the NBA for Sunday
content.text: What We Know After Sunday’s Games -The Thunder complete a comeback to defeat the Timberwolves: Minnesota maintained a nine-point lead midway through the third quarter in a road game against OKC, but the Thunder did what they do best. They outscored Minnesota 69-50 in the second half to complete a comeback victory. -Dallas pulls off an upset win in Cleveland: The Mavericks had one of their best road wins of the season, grabbing a 130-120 win over the Cavaliers. Dallas shot 53 percent from the field and 50 percent from 3-point range. Cooper Flagg also flirted with a triple-double, finishing with 27 points, six rebounds and 10 assists. -New York grabs comeback win over Golden State on NBC: The Warriors led by 21 points in the second quarter, but the Knicks pulled out a comeback win at home. Jalen Brunson led the team with 30 points while Karl-Anthony Towns recorded a double-double.
